scope: Passive current ROOT filesystem observation only; NO Git use and NOT base086 immutable checkout qualification
source_notes: Single and list ON_RESUME observers refresh every tracked state and remove the exact observer on disposal.
Real public rememberPermissionState/rememberMultiplePermissionsState delegate to Android states unless LocalInspectionMode is active; native candidate must prove ordinary real Activity composition.
Android31+ Fine expands to COARSE+FINE; Android29 background staged after foreground; Android30+ explicit app Settings path, no silent foreground escalation.
Notification maps to POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android33+; openAppSettings selects ACTION_APP_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS/EXTRA_APP_PACKAGE on Android26+.
Main-thread request gate tracks one prompt and callbacks, handles disposal and preserves legacy common public API.
